title: A component — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of a component of a library (DEC-001 points 4 and 6, DEC-005 points 1 to 3): its status and what it is about, the fields of content it takes, its options, states, colour, values, the size it prefers, its parts, the fields of each list it repeats over, the parts it exposes, whether it takes ends, its component tokens, the layouts of a top component, which may be its pages' forms, the physical size a top's pages print at, and, on a brand's component, the top and the layout it draws. `fields` is a fixed subset of JSON Schema 2020-12. Each part is exactly one kind, with the keys that kind takes; a value is a formula or a switch on an option of words, or on a size axis a piece can name, by its marked name, or, in a drawing of a layout, on whether its instance is a page, by `:as`. What crosses keys, such as a formula's references and dimensions, a switch naming every word of its option, or a field a part names, or a list's fields naming a list a part of its own repeats over, the engine checks when it reads the component. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:component`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

status.description: What its library promises of it (DEC-003 point 7). Every component carries one, but a drawing, which carries none (DEC-034 point 8).

about.description: What the component is for, in words.

options.description: Its options, by name: words, or an item (and its point) of a list it declares.

states.description: Its states, by name, each with the colour family it paints with.

values.description: Its named values, by name, each a formula or a switch of them.

parts.description: Its parts, by name, drawn in order.

lists.description: The fields of each list a `repeat` part of its own repeats over, by the list field (DEC-010 points 1 to 4, DEC-011 point 1): the field of an item that names the component drawing it, the item's arrangement fields, and, for a list of ties, its two end fields. The list of a top's pages takes none.

exposes.description: The parts a component that places it may read; an exposed image exposes its picture's points too.

ends.description: Whether it takes ends (DEC-011 point 1): drawn as a tie, its pattern gives it two, which its formulas read as `{start}` and `{end}`, and a line with `connect` joins.

tokens.description: Its component tokens, by name (DEC-004 point 7, DEC-035 points 1, 2 and 4): each a role at `component.<library>.<component>.<name>` that a brand naming the library may give a value, with its type, any a role takes but `picture`, and its default, always given, an alias to a role, which it takes wherever no brand gives it a value. Only the component reads them, by their full paths; a piece's own component declares none.

physical-size.description: The trim size a top's pages print at, in millimetres (DEC-034 point 3): on a page alone, or a top whose layouts are its pages' forms, and no other component. No formula reads it. The top asks for its height through it, so its `preferred` says no height: the engine sets the height from the width it asks for and the size's proportion.

layouts.description: A top component's layouts, by name: one, whose slots name the top's fields; or, where the layouts are the forms its pages take, one or more, each drawing a page with its own parts.

draws.description: On a brand's component, the top it draws, by `<library>/<component>`, and the one of its layouts it draws, which makes it a drawing (DEC-009 point 2, DEC-034 point 1). A drawing declares nothing the content gives: it takes the top's fields, the layout's slots and lists, the top's options, states and colour, so its file holds none of `fields`, `options`, `states`, `colour`, `lists`, `layouts` and `ends`. Nothing names a drawing, so it carries no `status` (DEC-034 point 8).

field-schema.description: The subset of JSON Schema 2020-12 a component's `fields` takes in format 1 (v3 of the walking skeleton's design): `type`, `properties`, `required`, `items`, `minItems`, `maxItems`, `enum`, `const`, `description`, `x-pkit-prose`, `x-pkit-pages`, `x-pkit-runs`, a local `$ref`, and `additionalProperties` only as `false`, which its absence means too. No property takes a reserved key's name.

x-pkit-pages.description: The field holds a top component's pages, each in one of its layouts. Only a list field of the top's own fields takes it.

x-pkit-runs.description: The field is a field of runs: content gives it text, read as one run in its first style, or a list of runs, each text or `{text, style?, concept?}` (visual-communication DEC-012 points 1 and 2). The words of its run styles, the first the default; `by` is none of them. Only one of the component's own fields, or a slot of a layout that draws a page, takes it, and only where its `type` is `string` alone and it holds no `enum`, `const` or `$ref`.

formula.description: A formula: text that starts with `=` and computes one number from numbers, `+ - * /`, parentheses, `min max round`, roles (`@<token path>`), the engine's names (`:width :height :index :count`, and in a `cross-size` alone `:place :places`), the component's values and the frames it may reach (DEC-005 points 1 and 3). The engine checks what it reads and its dimensions.

chooser.description: What a switch chooses by: an option of words, a field of runs where a text's style, fill, sign or ground switches, or a size axis a piece can name by its marked name, `:<axis>`, which the switch names the default mode of (DEC-021 point 3); or, in a drawing of a layout, `:as`, whose values are `page`, the default, and `part` (DEC-034 point 7).

size-name.description: A marked name: a size axis, `:<axis>`, such as `:device` (DEC-021 point 3), or `:as`, which a drawing of a layout alone reads (DEC-034 point 7).

number-value.description: A number the component computes: a formula, or a switch on an option of words, each word a number-value.

number-switch.description: A switch: `by` names an option of words, and every word of it a value.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

paint.description: A paint: a colour role's token path, or `:colour.<member>`, a member of the instance's colour family; or a switch on an option of words, whose branch may be null to paint nothing.

paint-switch.description: A switch of paints: `by` names an option of words, or, for a text's `fill` or `ground`, the field of runs the text shows, whose paint each run then takes by its style (DEC-012 point 2, DEC-036 point 3); a word's paint may be null.

by.description: The option of words, or the field of runs, the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

place-colour.description: The colour family a list's places take: a colour family, or a switch of them on an option of words.

place-colour-switch.description: A switch of the families a list's places take: `by` names an option of words, and every word of it a colour family, `:steps`, an order's steps spread over the places the list draws (DEC-032 points 3 and 4), or null, no family from the pattern.

by.description: The option of words the families switch on.

yes-or-no.description: `true` or `false`; or a switch of them on an option of words, or, for a text's `sign`, on the field of runs the text shows, whose each run then takes the one its style chooses (DEC-036 point 3).

yes-or-no-switch.description: A switch of `true` and `false` on an option of words, or on the field of runs a text shows.

by.description: The option of words, or the field of runs, the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

role-value.description: A role by its token path, such as a text's typography; or a switch of them on an option of words.

role-switch.description: A switch of roles on an option of words, or, for a text's `style`, on the field of runs the text shows, whose typography role each run then takes by its style (DEC-012 point 2).

by.description: The option of words, or the field of runs, the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

word-value.description: A word of an option a placed component declares; or a switch of words on an option of words of this component.

word-switch.description: A switch of words on an option of words.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

text-anchor-value.description: `text-anchor`: one of start, middle, end, the first the default; or a switch of them on an option of words.

text-anchor-switch.description: A switch of `text-anchor` words on an option of words.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

align-items-value.description: `align-items`: one of stretch, start, center, end, the first the default; or a switch of them on an option of words. Beside a `cross-size` that gives a size, a value left out places each item at the start of the line, and `stretch` is refused, as a value with two owners (visual-communication DEC-038 points 3 and 7).

align-items-switch.description: A switch of `align-items` words on an option of words.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

cross-size-value.description: `cross-size`: a formula that gives each item its size across the line, read at the item's place, which it alone reads as `:place`, from 1, with how many items its list draws as `:places`; or a switch of them, whose branch may be null to give none (visual-communication DEC-038 points 1 and 2).

cross-size-switch.description: A switch of `cross-size` formulas on an option of words; a word's formula may be null, where the list gives its items no size across the line.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

justify-content-value.description: `justify-content`: one of start, center, end, space-between, the first the default; or a switch of them on an option of words.

justify-content-switch.description: A switch of `justify-content` words on an option of words.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

sizes-value.description: `sizes`: one of own, equal, shares, the first the default; or a switch of them on an option of words. `shares` shares the line among the items by their list's weight.

sizes-switch.description: A switch of `sizes` words on an option of words.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

marker-value.description: `marker-start`, `marker-end`: the arrowhead at that end of a line, one of none, arrow, the first the default; or a switch of them on an option of words.

marker-switch.description: A switch of `marker` words on an option of words.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

connect-value.description: `connect`: how a connector runs between its component's two ends, straight or with corners; or a switch of them on an option of words.

connect-switch.description: A switch of `connect` words on an option of words.

by.description: The option of words the value switches on, or the size axis, by its marked name.

when.description: When a part is drawn: while a field of the content is filled, while an option of words takes one of the words named, or by a marked name: a switch on a size axis, or, in a drawing of a layout, on `:as`, whose each branch says `true`, `false`, or one of the other two (DEC-021 point 3, DEC-034 point 7).

when-switch.description: A `when` by a marked name: `by` names a size axis by its marked name, and each other key a mode of it, the axis's default among them, which takes each mode it leaves out; or `by` names `:as`, and each other key `page`, the default, or `part`. Each branch says yes, no, a field, or an option's words, never a switch.

by.description: The size axis the part is drawn by, or `:as`.

option.description: An option: a list of words, the first the default; or `{item: <list field>}`, naming an item of that list by its id; or `{item: <list field>, point: true}`, naming an item and one of its exposed points.

list-fields.description: The fields of a list's items (DEC-010 points 1 to 4, DEC-011 point 1): `component`, a field of the component's own, holding no list and placed by no part, whose value names the component of each item that names none of its own; `arrangement`, the item's arrangement fields by name, each an option of words that the list's component sets, which a component that draws an item declares under no key of its own; and `ends`, a list of ties' two end fields, where each tie starts and where it ends. The list takes one weight at most.

component.description: The field whose value names the component that draws each item of the list naming none of its own.

arrangement.description: The item's arrangement fields, by name.

ends.description: The list's two end fields, in order: the field of each tie that names the item it starts at, and the one it ends at. Each is a name, no reserved key's, and no arrangement field of the list.

arrangement-field.description: An arrangement field: the words it takes, the first the default; and, for the list's weight, the share of its line that each word gives an item.

words.description: The words it takes, the first the default.

shares.description: The weight's share for each of its words, a number above zero; it names every word and no other.

state.description: A state: the colour family it paints with, or `{}` to keep the instance's.

colour.description: The colour family the state paints with.

layout.description: A layout of a top component. In format 1 its slots name the top's fields. In a layout that is a page's form, each slot is the schema of a field the page fills, which `x-pkit-runs` may mark as a field of runs, `required` names the slots a page must fill, `preferred` the height of its page by a formula on its parts, which it says where the top asks for no height and never a width (DEC-022 point 3), `lists` declares the fields of each list among its slots that its parts repeat over, as a pattern does, and `parts` draw the page.

slots.description: The slots of the layout, each a field the content fills.

required.description: The slots a page in this layout must fill.

preferred.description: The height of a page in this layout, by a formula on its parts. It says no width, since a page gets the top's (DEC-022 point 3).

lists.description: The fields of each list among the slots that a part of the layout repeats over, by the slot (DEC-010 point 5, DEC-011 point 5).

parts.description: The parts that draw a page in this layout, by name, drawn in order.

box.description: A box's properties, by SVG's names.

ellipse.description: An ellipse's properties, by SVG's names.

text.description: A text's properties: the field or the fact of its export it shows, one of the two, its typography role, and SVG's names. Where the field it shows is a field of runs, its `style` and `fill` may switch on the field's run styles, and each run takes the role and paint its style chooses. Such a text alone may take `sign` and `ground`, which may switch on the run styles too (DEC-036 point 3).

content.description: The field of text it shows, a field of runs included.

fact.description: The fact of its export it shows: the version's number, its date, its language or the piece's state. It takes no switch and no run styles.

sign.description: Whether a run that names a concept with a sign draws it before its first character that is no space or line feed, in the run's paint (DEC-036 point 3). Only a text that shows a field of runs takes it.

ground.description: The paint drawn behind a run, its sign included, or none where a switch's branch is null (DEC-036 point 3). Only a text that shows a field of runs takes it.

line.description: A line's properties, by SVG's names.

rx.description: The radius a connector's turns are drawn round at; with none, or 0, they are sharp. Only a line that connects its component's ends takes it.

image.description: An image's properties: what it shows, exactly one of a produced output, a picture file the content names, a picture file of the component's own library, and a picture role, whose file the brand gives (visual-communication DEC-025 points 1 and 4).

produced.description: The field naming a produced output of the piece.

content.description: The field whose text is the bare name of a picture file in the piece's `pictures/`; each language's content names its own, and an empty field draws nothing.

file.description: The bare name of a picture file in the `pictures/` of the component's own library version, or of the piece for a local component: the same in every mode and under every brand.

role.description: A picture role, such as `picture.logo`: the brand's file for it in each mode; where the brand gives it none, the image is not drawn.

sign.description: A sign's properties, by SVG's names: it is painted as a box is (DEC-036 point 2).

operator.description: How a list's items are arranged along a row or a column, by CSS flexible layout's names.

text-part.description: A text: its height is its measured text's, so it gives none.

line-part.description: A line, from `x1 y1` to `x2 y2`; or, in a component that takes ends, a connector between them, `connect`, which sets its ends.

line.description: A line of its own ends turns nowhere, so it takes no radius of a connector's turns.

image-part.description: An image of a produced output, a picture file or a picture role: its height keeps the picture's proportions where none is given.

sign-part.description: A sign: the sign of the concept whose colour family its instance takes, fitted into its frame by its square, and not drawn, at zero size, where there is none (DEC-036 point 2).

fields.description: The placed component's fields, each given a field of this component.

options.description: The placed component's options, each given a word.

slot-part.description: The component the content places in a field.

slot.description: The field whose component the content places here.

repeat-part.description: A component drawn for each item of a list, arranged in a row or a column; or, over a list of ties, each tie drawn in the part's whole frame, with neither.

repeat.description: The list field whose items it draws.

draw.description: The component that draws an item that names none of its own, where the list declares no component field or the field is not filled.

colour.description: The items' default colour family, the family of each place of its list (DEC-010 point 6); or a switch of them on an option of words, under whose word the places may take an order's steps instead (DEC-032 point 3).

part.description: A part: exactly one of a primitive (`box ellipse text line image sign`) or a placing (`use slot repeat`), with its place, its size and `when`.
